item.title: Wacky Files
item.description:
Find the wackiest ways to store files for free and earn $3/hour with multipliers!

Deadline: March 1, 2026

Sick of cloud-based storage? Own your files the weird way! Find the wackiest and most creative ways to host files for free. Convert binary to static and upload to YouTube, 3D print notches to encode data, or invent something completely absurd - just keep it wacky! Requirements: - Must be able to store the test banana image in all its yellow glory - Solution must be reproducible and documented - A representation is okay (storing binary without rendering is fine) - Must be able to upload AND download the file - Track time with Hackatime (use Lapse for hardware projects) Earn $3/hour baseline, with voting multipliers: ⭐ = 1x, ⭐⭐ = 2x, ⭐⭐⭐ = 3x

Join the discussion in #wacky-files

item.title: You Spud, We Spud
item.description:
Build a fast, lightweight website or game using pure vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS under strict size constraints (<15KB, <5KB, <2KB)!

Challenge yourself to build fast, lightweight, dependency free web applications using only vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! Earn custom Aussie loot and potato themed rewards based on how compact your project's total bundle size is across three difficulty tiers. **STANDARD MODE (<15KB):** - Custom Orpheus-as-a-spud sticker - Handwritten airmail postcard from Sami - Random Aussie trading card (whatever's in the drawer) - Temporary potato tattoo - Your link featured in the ship channel forever **HARD MODE (<5KB):** - Everything from Standard Mode - Sealed packet of Australian chicken salt - Surprise Aussie snack pack - A "Coding Down Under" playlist made for you **ULTRA HARD MODE (<2KB):** - Everything from Hard Mode - Flat packet of instant mashed potatoes - A badly hand-drawn potato portrait of you - Featured on sami-s.dev's Hall of Fame - Sami's genuine respect

Join the discussion in #youspudwespud
